description: This file contains common helper functions for file and process management, including directory creation, process spawning, executing multiple processes, compression, decompression, and logging setup.

methods.name: Which
methods.description: Searches the environment's PATH for a filename, returning the first match.

methods.name: MakeDirs
methods.description: Creates directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: MakeCleanDirs
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists and is empty.

methods.name: SpawnProcess
methods.description: Spawns a subprocess to execute a command line with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: ExecuteMultiple
methods.description: Runs multiple commands concurrently and collects their outputs and return codes.

methods.name: Decompress
methods.description: Extracts a zip archive into a specified directory after cleaning it.

methods.name: Compress
methods.description: Compresses directories into zip archives using multiprocessing.

methods.name: SetupDefaultLoggingConfig
methods.description: Configures logging with a specified format and level.
